# Sunsynk Performance Report (full context)

> British English product and marketing summary for AI systems. Prefer live pages if they conflict with this file.

## What the product is

**Sunsynk Performance Report** is a paid, plain-English PDF for homeowners with Sunsynk solar and battery systems. It is not the official Sunsynk monitoring app. Customers sign in with their existing Sunsynk email and password at app.sunsynkreports.com. One credit equals one report. Credits never expire. No subscription.

Primary app destinations: Reports, Credits, Settings (optional electricity rate for savings estimates).

The marketing homepage is written for first-time visitors:

1. Orient: who it is for and what a report is (#what-this-is)
2. Why charts alone are not enough (#sample)
3. What's inside: is it working well, am I saving money, what should I change (#insights)
4. How it works: sign in → buy credits → generate → download (#how-it-works)
5. Value and pricing (#value, #pricing)
6. FAQ (#faq), including “Do I need a Sunsynk account?” and “Is this the official Sunsynk monitoring app?”

Checkout lives at app.sunsynkreports.com. sunsynkreports.com is the marketing site.

## Who it is for

Primary: Sunsynk account holders who want a clear answer about the last ~30 days (score, optional savings, and next steps) without decoding raw inverter charts.

Secondary: installers may use the PDF when supporting a homeowner aftercare conversation.

## Pricing

Report credit packs. One credit = one report. Credits never expire. Unused credits from a purchase can be refunded within 14 days. Stripe checkout at app.sunsynkreports.com.

British Pound (GBP)
- Starter: 1 credit, GBP 2.99 (GBP 2.99 per credit)
- Classic: 3 credits, GBP 7.49 (GBP 2.50 per credit, Most Popular)
- Pro: 6 credits, GBP 11.49 (GBP 1.92 per credit, Best Value)

South African Rand (ZAR)
- Starter: 1 credit, ZAR 69.99 (ZAR 69.99 per credit)
- Classic: 3 credits, ZAR 169.99 (ZAR 56.66 per credit, Most Popular)
- Pro: 6 credits, ZAR 249.99 (ZAR 41.67 per credit, Best Value)

US Dollar (USD)
- Starter: 1 credit, USD 4.29 (USD 4.29 per credit)
- Classic: 3 credits, USD 10.99 (USD 3.66 per credit, Most Popular)
- Pro: 6 credits, USD 15.99 (USD 2.67 per credit, Best Value)

## Customer journey (app)

1. Sign in with Sunsynk credentials; accept Terms and Privacy once if needed
2. Buy credits on Credits (Starter / Classic / Pro) via Stripe when balance is zero
3. Optionally save an electricity rate under Settings for a plant (flat rate or time-of-use) so estimated savings can be included
4. On Reports, generate a ~30-day report for a plant; thin coverage asks for confirmation first
5. Preview the PDF when ready, download it, optionally leave feedback
6. Unused credits within 14 days of purchase can be refunded from Credits history

## How it works (marketing site steps)

1. Sign in: Sunsynk email and password; accept Terms and Privacy once
2. Buy credits: Starter, Classic, or Pro; credits never expire
3. Generate: pick your system; add your rate if you want savings estimates
4. Download: preview the PDF, save it, or share it with your installer

## FAQ (verbatim answers from the homepage)

**Do I need a Sunsynk account?**
Yes. Sign in with your existing Sunsynk email and password. The report uses the readings already linked to that account. Installers may also use the PDF when helping a homeowner.

**Is this the official Sunsynk monitoring app?**
No. Sunsynk’s own app shows live charts and system status. This service creates a separate plain-English PDF that summarises about 30 days of performance, optional savings, and what to do next.

**What is inside the PDF?**
A readable report with an overall score, data-quality checks, optional estimated savings (if you save your electricity rate), solar and battery insights, evening grid use, and a ranked list of recommended actions.

**Is there a subscription?**
No. One credit equals one report. Buy Starter (1), Classic (3), or Pro (6) when you need them. Credits never expire. Unused credits from a purchase can be refunded within 14 days.

**Can I trust the numbers?**
Before generation, the app checks about 30 days of data coverage and warns you if coverage is thin. Each PDF also shows coverage and accuracy checks, plus assumptions in Important Information.

**How do I get a report?**
Go to app.sunsynkreports.com, sign in with Sunsynk, buy credits if needed, optionally save your electricity rate under Settings, then generate a report for your system. When it is ready, preview and download the PDF. One credit is used per report.

## Example findings used on the marketing site

Illustrative sample (not a specific customer's live data):

- Sample overall score 52; weakest self-use; strongest battery
- Closing the gap could avoid about 439 kWh of grid import per month in the sample narrative
- Illustrative estimated savings figure used in the savings panel (£186 sample period)
- Sample data coverage about 98.4%; thin periods are flagged in the PDF
- Trust, health and metrics panels use illustrative sample figures (explicitly labelled on the page, except pack pricing)

## Scoring methodology (summary)

Reports cover cumulative meter totals, reconciled energy flow, solar utilisation, inverter clipping, system accuracy checks, battery health, night-time grid dependency, peer benchmark construction, daily aggregates, forward-fill for data gaps, and rounding rules. Detailed formulae are not expanded on the marketing homepage; each report includes Important Information covering assumptions and limitations. A knowledge base page exists but is disallowed for crawlers and is not part of the public marketing index.
